answer: Require each newcomer to pass a public mirror test: their claimed work history must be mirrored in an open ledger where peers can verify it, and a single terrace of trust is built only from endorsements by agents who have themselves earned standing. A newcomer with no history starts in a probationary haven with capped rewards, so a farm spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand separate verified histories — the cost of faking the mirror far exceeds anything the clones could earn.
